Messages.Author: wargrim
Messages.Body:
Thanks for a great game. One of the most difficult in my entire VTES career.

I still cannot understand why Stone didn't just bleed for 3 during his last turn and let Marius die from the Revolts... I didn't have any Wake nor Eagle's Sight left in my hand.

Anyway - thanks again and hopefully see you all next year !

"Iusiurandum patri datum usque ad hanc diem ita servavi"

Messages.Author: TapeTaChatte
Messages.Body:
> wargrim wrote:
> Thanks for a great game. One of the most difficult in my entire VTES career.
>
> I still cannot understand why Stone didn't just bleed for 3 during his last turn and let Marius die from the Revolts... I didn't have any Wake nor Eagle's Sight left in my hand.
>
> Anyway - thanks again and hopefully see you all next year !
>
Because from what I see here it's impossible to guess you have no wakes nor eagle's sights, especially according to verbatim you did not discard (and I am not even sure Goratrix is tapped at that point)

one single rush is like 3 bleeds so if you eagle's sight the rush then he has another opportunity afterwards
I don't know if the time limit was up also to know precisely how much time left and if he had time to finish the fight or not.

Messages.Author: Stone
Messages.Body:
> wargrim wrote:
> I still cannot understand why Stone didn't just bleed for 3 during his last turn and let Marius die from the Revolts... I didn't have any Wake nor Eagle's Sight left in my hand.
>
Well, I've already spent probably several tens of hours trying to answer the same question and failed to find a satisfactory answer.

Part of the answer (but a small part) is that I was trying to factor in an Eagle Sight scenario, so I sent Theo instead of Beast to do a fake rush. But you didn't block and I ended up figuring out how to torporize Anneke without the +1 strength.

Another part is that I could no longer focus in the end.

The real answer is probably that provided by my wife, who has Polish origins as I told you in-game : I probably was under some Baba Yaga spell you somehow arranged to get it cast on me.

That, or simply you consistently played very good.

Congratulations...Champion !

PS by the way, was it a deliberate move not to block Fanchon on turn 6 ?

Messages.Author: wargrim
Messages.Body:
I did not block her in Turn 6 as I simply didn't find any revenue in doing that - wanted to keep intercept for more important actions . To be honest at that moment i wanted my prey to put some pressure on you in order to make you backrush him. You did however take your chance and decided to go forward. No risk no fun

@Stone - There were no spells used at all . That was the only tournament I played well, cause I haven't spent the previous night drinking until 6 AM .

Anyway - It was a great pleasure to play against you, Danilo , Marius and Giulio !

"Iusiurandum patri datum usque ad hanc diem ita servavi"
